assessments.title: Find My Level
assessments.description: A friendly check across phonics, reading, vocabulary, spelling and writing. It suggests where to start teaching in each area — a starting point, not a test score or a school grade.

stages.label: Sentences with capitals and full stops

assessments.title: Phonics Check
assessments.description: A short check of letters, sounds, blending, segmenting, digraphs, patterns, reading and spelling. One try per question; the parent sees a score for each area.

assessments.title: Skill re-check
assessments.description: A short re-check of a skill the child has practised since a check found it weak. Questions the child has seen least are chosen.

assessments.title: Review check
assessments.description: A quick check of the skills that are due for review.

assessments.title: Progress check
assessments.description: Checks each area at the level the child is learning now, to see whether it is time to move on.

assessments.title: Diagnostic check
assessments.description: A closer look at one area: one question for each skill of the level the child is learning, so the parent sees exactly which skills are secure.

assessments.title: End of unit check
assessments.description: Checks the skills of one unit after it has been finished.
